mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate indicates a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the instances when the federal funds rate decreases by >0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate increases by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts indicates growing demand in the economy, which is likely to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the instances when housing starts increase by >5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the instances when industrial production decreases by >2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index indicates inflationary pressure, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the instances when the consumer price index increases by >2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP signals economic growth, which is likely to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the instances when real GDP increases by >1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market, which is likely to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >0.5% and UNRATE decreases by >0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the instances when nonfarm payrolls increase and unemployment rate decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales signals weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the instances when retail sales decrease by >2%.
